revenue_cells.revenue_row_concept: NOT a single printed row. GICRE's IRDAI-format P&L prints no 'Revenue from Operations' line. The figure reported here is the sum of three separately-labelled rows, validated by column-anchor against comparator quarters (see evidence): row 3 'Premium Earned (Net)' [policyholders' account] + row 4 'Income from investments (net)' [policyholders' account] + row 18(b) 'Income from investments' [shareholders' account, listed under 'Income in shareholders' account (a+b+c)']. This explicitly EXCLUDES row 5 'Other income - Foreign exchange Gain/(Loss)' and row 18(c) 'Other income' (shareholders' side) on both bases - matching the convention documented in DATA_RUNBOOK.md §43 ('policyholders' [premium earned (net) + ... interest, dividend & rent] PLUS shareholders' [interest, dividend & rent ...]; other income excluded').
